tests.scope: CPU contracts, profiling payload identity / baseline selection / all-row failure gates, provenance, existing CUDA helpers and production vc25 helpers on SM86. No full Hopper attention execution.
tests.helper_result: Tested P bytes, maximum/alpha/mass/denominator/history match same-algorithm baseline at zero tolerance. Independent FP8 decode sum and masked-zero checks pass.
tests.cases: 1/2/7/296 tiles; stable/rising/sparse maxima; lane-specific scales; nondefault stream; affine/extreme fallback transitions; initial neutral tile; masked final tile including single-tile attention.

sm90a_cross_compile.placement: D128 steady-state QK batch contains 32 paired FP8 decodes before wait. Main PV batch contains zero. Compiler may reschedule independent final-tile work.
sm90a_cross_compile.source_schedule_comparison: Before/during-QK source variants have identical SASS instruction text locally in all four dim/dtype pairs. They do not isolate serial/overlap performance.
sm90a_cross_compile.scope: Static SASS instruction text only; excludes encodings/control words, execution, hardware counters and speed. Remote CUDA 13 may generate different code.

h200_validation: Not run locally. Remote script validates before timing: 240 dtype/shape/algorithm cases repeated 3 times, 16 uniform-attention known answers and 24 fixed-payload maximum/scale cases for new modes.
h200_performance: Unmeasured. Acceptance requires same-run vc22_both full API improvement and implementation gate. No speedup or 22 ms claim.
default_kernel: vc15 unchanged; vc22_both measured experimental baseline
